title: SiteDrift
tagline: Don't waste your time with compliance. SiteDrift automatically skips annoying link shorteners.
overview: SiteDrift is a universal bypass browser extension that automatically skips annoying link shorteners and compliance pages. Available for Chrome and Firefox, it saves users time by eliminating forced redirects and wait timers.
problem: Link shorteners and compliance redirect pages waste users' time with forced wait timers, tracking, and unnecessary clicks before reaching the actual destination.
solution: SiteDrift intercepts and bypasses link shorteners automatically as you browse. No manual action needed — it works silently in the background across Chrome and Firefox.
